articles.title: ICT Risk Management Framework
articles.requirement: Financial entities shall have in place a sound, comprehensive and well-documented ICT risk management framework ensuring high resilience, continuous data protection, and least-privilege computing environments.

articles.title: Protection and Prevention
articles.requirement: Ensure data security through cryptographic measures at rest, in transit, and in use, ensuring that cryptographic keys are independently managed and rotated.
mitigations: AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys with annual rotation (CKV_AWS_7)
Additive S3 AES-256 / KMS default encryption attachments (CKV_AWS_19 / CKV_AWS_145)

articles.title: Detection of Anomalous Activities
articles.requirement: Deploy mechanisms to promptly detect anomalous activities, including network performance issues and ICT incidents, with tamper-proof event logging.
mitigations: Multi-region CloudTrail logging with KMS envelope encryption (CKV_AWS_36)
Immutable S3 object versioning for audit logs (CKV_AWS_21)

articles.title: Backup Policies and Disaster Recovery
articles.requirement: Financial entities shall maintain continuous data backup systems and multi-availability zone deployments to ensure operational continuity without data loss.
mitigations: Multi-AZ PostgreSQL deployment across independent availability zones
S3 object versioning (CKV_AWS_21) preventing accidental deletion or state corruption
